about_the_game:
Thank you so much for enjoying the relaxing deep-sea world of FISHTOPIA! If you love the game's cozy vibe and would like to further support our development efforts, this Supporter Pack is our way of saying thank you. It offers you a unique collectible and some useful in-game items as a token of our heartfelt appreciation.

The Supporter Pack contains:

  • 1 × Exclusive Wonderland Card "The Time Temple": A supporter-exclusive Wonderland Card that can be used as a clock

  • 10 × "The Time Temple" Full Set of Ornament Cards: A complete set of ornaments matching "The Time Temple" for you to mix and match freely

  • 5 × Nutrition Cards: Provide rich nutrients to your fish to speed up their growth

  • 5 × Capacity Cards: Expand the capacity of your fish tank

 

[How to Claim]

After purchasing and downloading this DLC, please restart the game. The items from the Supporter Pack will be delivered automatically.

 

Thank you again for your support. We hope these special gifts make your time in FISHTOPIA even more enjoyable!
